remarks: This is it! A renovated in-town rental that perfectly blends comfort, convenience, and modern living. Ideally situated just steps from vibrant shops, popular restaurants, and easy transportation options, this home offers an easy lifestyle in a prime location.  Enjoy the ease of single-floor living with a thoughtfully updated interior made up of two bedrooms and one and half baths with plenty of storage. All new appliances as part of the updates.  Step outside to your own private, fenced-in yard-perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying a bit of outdoor space in the heart of town.  Whether you're commuting, dining out, or simply enjoying the neighborhood, this home puts everything you need right at your doorstep. An opportunity to enjoy updated living with privacy and convenience all in one. Tenant responsible for all utilities, credit check, two months security deposit. No smoking.
